title: Raven vs Crow Chronicles
description: Navigate court intrigue and ancient magic in a world ruled by corvids
author: Hyperbaby Games

prologue.title: The Court Summons
content: The scroll arrives at dawn, sealed with black wax bearing the twin sigils: a raven clutching a crescent moon, and a crow grasping a rising sun.
You unfurl the parchment with careful talons. The message is brief but commands attention:
**'Your presence is required at the Convergence. Both Courts await. Choose your allegiance wisely.'**
In the world of Corvidae, the Raven Kingdom and the Crow Empire have maintained an uneasy truce for three generations. But whispers of war grow louder with each passing season.
You are a Grackle—neither raven nor crow—which means both courts seek your service, and neither fully trusts you.

choices.text: Accept the summons and prepare to meet both courts
Investigate the summons' authenticity before committing
Ignore the summons and continue your independent work

metadata.location: Your dwelling in the Neutral Territories

chapter1_diplomatic.title: The Grand Hall
content: You arrive at the Convergence Hall at twilight, as custom dictates. The building stands at the exact border between territories—half obsidian stone (Raven), half white marble (Crow).

Inside, the hall divides down the center. To your left, the Raven delegation perches in shadow, their dark plumage gleaming like oil in candlelight. To your right, the Crows arrange themselves in formation, their grey-silver feathers catching the fading sunlight through tall windows.
Lady Murk of the Ravens catches your eye first. She inclines her head with calculated courtesy.
"Welcome, Grackle. We've heard of your... neutral perspective. Perhaps you can see what we cannot."
Before you can respond, Commander Ash of the Crows speaks: "Or perhaps a Grackle sees only opportunity. Tell me—where do your true loyalties lie?"

choices.text: Address both courts: 'I serve neither kingdom, but I serve peace between both'
Lean toward the Ravens: 'My work often aligns with Raven interests'
Lean toward the Crows: 'The Crow Empire's methods appeal to my sensibilities'
Deflect with humor: 'My loyalties lie with whoever feeds me best'

chapter1_cautious.title: Investigation
content: Something about the summons feels off. The wax seal is legitimate, but the timing is suspicious—right when tensions between the kingdoms are at their peak.
You spend the next three days quietly investigating. Your contacts in the neutral markets provide valuable intel:
Both courts did issue the summons. But they issued it separately. Neither knows the other is also summoning you.
This isn't a joint Convergence—it's a competition. Both courts want you to choose their side before the other can make their offer.
Armed with this knowledge, you have leverage. But how will you use it?

choices.text: Attend the Convergence and play both sides against each other
Inform both courts that you know their game
Use the knowledge to demand better terms from both

chapter1_independent.title: The Isolationist
content: You burn the summons. Neither court owns you, and you refuse to be a pawn in their political games.
For two weeks, life continues as normal. You take contracts from merchants, solve disputes in the neutral zones, and keep your distance from court politics.
But on the fifteenth day, three crows in royal livery appear at your door.
"The Empire does not take kindly to ignored summons," their leader states coldly.
Before you can respond, shadows coalesce on your roof. Ravens.
"Neither does the Kingdom," a voice calls down.
Both delegations are here. And they're not leaving until you choose.

choices.text: Defend your independence with force if necessary
Agree to meet with both courts on YOUR terms

metadata.consequence: Both courts are now aware of your position

chapter2_peacekeeper.title: The Mediator's Path
content: Your declaration of neutrality earns you cautious nods from both sides. It's not the answer either court wanted, but it's one they can respect.
Lady Murk gestures to a chair at the exact center of the hall. "Very well. If you serve peace, then mediate our current dispute."
Commander Ash adds, "Three days ago, a Crow merchant vessel was attacked in Raven waters. We demand justice."
"The vessel," Lady Murk counters smoothly, "was carrying contraband talismans. Old magic that the treaties explicitly forbid."
Both courts turn to you. This is your first test.

choices.text: Investigate the merchant vessel incident thoroughly
Propose a joint tribunal with representatives from both courts
Suggest this is a distraction from a larger issue

chapter2_raven_lean.title: Shadow Court
content: The Crows bristle at your statement, several rising from their perches. Commander Ash's eyes narrow, but he maintains composure.
"Very well," he says coldly. "The Empire will remember your choice."
The Crow delegation departs in formation, leaving you alone with the Ravens.
Lady Murk's demeanor shifts immediately—warmer, but no less calculating. "Smart choice, Grackle. The Kingdom values intelligence... and loyalty."
She beckons you to follow her deeper into the Raven side of the hall, where older, more powerful members of the court await in the shadows.

choices.text: Commit fully to the Raven cause
Maintain some distance while appearing loyal
Secretly maintain contact with Crow informants
